title: K-injective direct-image comparison commutes with shift
statement: For every ringed-space morphism and K-injective complex, the identity-resolution comparison for the right derived direct image intertwines the canonical shift comparisons.

proof.text: Apply the auxiliary shifted comparison component identity and cancel the inverse/localized shift isomorphism pair by associativity and simp.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso_shift
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ) [K.IsKInjective] :
    (derivedModuleDirectImage g).map
        ((DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).inv.app K) ≫
      (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)).hom ≫
      (moduleDirectImageLocalizedShiftIso g K).hom =
    ((derivedModuleDirectImage g).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
      (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g K).hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
